floor_history.headline: fable-blitz deep recon: 2991-insn CPU-AI think monster, whole-body asmfix; m2c clean (1321 lines); 3-switch jtbl-infra wall + cross-jump exit stubs identified; region map + scaffold-first attack seque
first full C body from m2c scaffold (raw-offset style, one variable per role)
callee-saved roles folded into five shared locals t1..t5 (target s1..s5); s3 is read uninitialized at the 9-case switch, so it is one variable function-wide
stack slots exact (spill order = declaration order), cross-jump stubs, fold/range spellings, D_800A38DC switch (case 3 first), u16 state local, abs form, per-region temps; candidate.c

t1..t5 now seat s1..s5 exactly: mask/char-mask kept in t3 with a (u32) operand (stops fold's (x&(1<<n))==0 -> (x>>n)&1 rewrite), random-pick and nav leg loops spelled as goto loops (loop-depth ref weighting decides the global.c order t2>t3>t4)

R1/R2 register-exact (447/449/445 statement order, table-loop state var split from st, 0xF-case value split); nav leg loop kept a C while loop (reorg fills its delay slot from the loop head only with a LOOP_BEG note); random-pick `score` is its own local (ablation: best of 11 single-role splits)
